title: My daughter directed the intro, my wife roasted the gameplay, and AI helped me build this. 😂
author: Equal_Nature6901
selftext:
​

Been working on Warden of the Wilds, a fantasy action RPG I'm building under Rooster Roost Studios.

Using Claude Code, Unity, Blender, and Meshy. Lots of AI assistance, but also plenty of rebuilding things when they look or play like crap. 😂

My daughter helped direct the opening cinematic, including how the forest's corruption spreads. (Complete genius saving me from tunnel vision) My wife became my unofficial QA tester and immediately found problems with the controls that were confusing, quests not updating, and tutorials that felt like it's adventure puzzles that I'd completely overlooked. Gotta love family feedback.

It's been a lot of trial, error, and figuring out what actually works. The game features spectral animal transformations, dual-dagger combat, magic, and Spirit Realm trials. I hated the hands and head Mages and animations. Find easy fix... generate weapon specific hand meshes. 

Everything in the trailer is actual in-game footage. No generated video pretending to be gameplay.

Getting close to putting the demo on Steam. (Nervous but been fun this far)

Curious what you guys think. What looks good, what looks rough, and would you actually play it?

Don't hold back. I've survived my wife's playtesting. 😂

comments.body: Sorry if used the wrong flair. I'll correct it if needed.

comments.author: wisedingus
comments.body:
You asked not to hold back so here it is -

It's quite rough around the edges, there are so many scene cuts/transitions that I don't even know what's going on. The scene cuts are quite jarring. Why do the animals have some milk substance on them? 

The vibes I get from this game = you go and fight animals = it's not enticing at all to me, there are millions of games where you go and fight animals in a 3D world, and those games aren't as rough/jank around the edges as this one. Like what is even happening at 0:30? The camera moves so much from animal to animal that I can't even tell what's going on.

What does your game do uniquely compared to other fantasy action RPGs? [https://howtomarketagame.com/2026/10/21/how-sloppy-is-the-october-2026-steam-next-fest/](https://howtomarketagame.com/2026/10/21/how-sloppy-is-the-october-2026-steam-next-fest/) The last Steam next fest indicated that RPGs are among the sloppiest of genres, you're going to have insane competition and the bar will be high. This video doesn't come close to clearing that bar.

replies.author: Equal_Nature6901
replies.body: Yeah this trailer does no justice at all especially if thats the impression you got. XD You are playing as a forest guardian druid able to transform into animals not fight them.
